{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now, calculate conversion rate using ALL orders (completed + refunded) as denominator
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of orders)
conversion_rates_all = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates_all['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates_all['sum'] / conversion_rates_all['count']

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_all['conversion_rate'].idxmax()

# Print results
conversion_rates_all, highest_segment"}
